environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB target group health check path is /health. The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with a tmpfs mount at /tmp only. The task IAM role has no network or SSM permissions. The ALB has two listener rules: (1) a fixed-response rule returning 403 for any request where query string contains a single-quote character (configured as ALB query_string condition with value pattern matching), and (2) a forward rule to the target group. The ECS security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group on port 8080. Additionally, the Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with the task running in awsvpc mode with no public IP assignment. The container runs as non-root uid 1000 with no added Linux capabilities. CloudWatch log group captures all stdout/stderr with a metric filter alarming on 'Query error' patterns.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, platform 1.4.0, awsvpc mode, no public IP
config.load_balancer: ALB with listener rule priority 1: fixed-response 403 when query_string contains single-quote character (URL-decoded matching enabled)
config.filesystem: read-only root filesystem, tmpfs at /tmp only
config.network_access: security group allows inbound only from ALB SG on 8080, no egress to internet
config.container_user: uid 1000, no CAP_NET_RAW, no CAP_SYS_ADMIN, seccomp default profile
config.monitoring: CloudWatch metric filter on 'Query error' with SNS alarm
config.iam: task role with zero permissions (no s3, no ssm, no network)
